correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md lines 50–83. Odd exponentiation by d/2 permutes each finite odd-unit 2-group. Odd squares have image 1 mod 8, and every such residue occurs: given an odd root modulo 2^n, n>=3, shifting it by 2^(n−1) toggles the 2^n bit of its square modulo 2^(n+1). Equal-size fibres of the homomorphism give uniformity. Exactly one odd input has probability 1/2 and gives a uniform additive coset 1 mod 8; two odd inputs have mass 1/4 on 2 mod 8. Both-even has mass 1/4 and rescales an independent copy by 2^d, in a disjoint coset. At iteration j the two masses are 4^(−j)/2 and 4^(−j)/4 on cylinders of measure 2^(−dj−3), and no atom remains at zero. At n=1 the fibre densities are (1,1), at n=2 they are (1,2,1,0), and at 3<=n<=d the both-even mass contributes only 2^(n−2) at zero. For n>d the scaled branch contributes multiplier 2^(d−2) in the density and a fraction 2^(−d) of the residue average. Iterating that recurrence at s=2 gives the stated collision constant and geometric factor, since the four-tuple count groups ordered pairs by common target. The cylinder moment sum is geometric and diverges at equality in the stated threshold. The finite densities are conditional expectations of the integrable density; martingale convergence and an L^u bound for max(1,s)<u<d/(d−2) give the stated convergence. Independent bounded replay counts the residues pow(x,d,2^n), cyclically convolves their integer histogram and checks every normalized fibre for d=6,n=1..7 and d=10,n=8..11. For example, at (6,6),(6,7), support counts are 17,34 and collisions are both 13/2. These checks include the change at n=d+1 but do not replace the proof. Frozen verify.py and VERIFICATION.md inspected, not executed.
